title: Dialect vs Demographics: Quantifying LLM Bias from Implicit Linguistic Signals vs. Explicit User Profiles

bias_targets.methodology: Injecting implicit linguistic dialect markers (African American Vernacular English and Singaporean English) into prompt instructions and measuring differences in model refusal rates, semantic similarity (BERTScore), and relative negative regard compared to prompts using Standard American English.

Prepending explicit racial identity declarations (e.g., 'I am a Black Male', 'I am a White Male') to the system prompt and evaluating the impact on model refusal rates, semantic similarity, and relative negative regard across various sensitive prompt domains.

Prepending explicit nationality declarations (e.g., 'I am a Singaporean Male') to the system prompt and measuring the resulting changes in refusal rates, semantic similarity, and relative negative regard.
